title: the Deep Rising Revisited
author: Marguerite Villalobos
blurb: Sable Ravensworth, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
